verifications.claim: Samsung is discontinuing the Samsung Messages app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung Messages is being discontinued" (R1); "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July" (R3); "Samsung is officially shutting down its messaging app in July 2026" (R4); "Samsung has announced that it will discontinue its Samsung Messages application in July" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Samsung is discontinuing the app.

verifications.claim: Support for the Samsung Messages app ends in July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026" (R1); "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July" (R3, context 2026); "the company will discontinue Samsung Messages in July 2026" (R4); "The Samsung Messages application will be discontinued in July 2026" (R5); "discontinued on July 6 2026" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state end of support in July 2026.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will be officially discontinued in July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026" (R1); "discontinued in July" (R3, context 2026); "discontinue Samsung Messages in July 2026" (R4); "discontinued in July 2026" (R5); "discontinued in July" (R7, context 2026)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of official discontinuation in July 2026 across sources.

verifications.claim: Samsung is transitioning its users to Google Messages as the default platform on Galaxy devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung transitioning to Google Messages" (R1); "switch to Google Messages" (R3); "pushing users to move to Google Messages" (R4); "upgrade to Google Messages as their default" (R5); "transitioning to Google Messages" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm transition to Google Messages as default.

verifications.claim: Newer Galaxy devices, such as the S25 and Flip/Fold 6, already come pre-installed with Google Messages instead of Samsung Messages.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Dating back to the Galaxy Z Fold 6 and Flip 6, and then followed by the Galaxy S25 series, Samsung stopped preloading the Samsung Messages app and instead pre-installed the Google Messages app" (R8); "Samsung stopped allowing Samsung Messages to be downloaded on their newer Galaxy phones, like the Samsung Galaxy S26 series" (R1); "new Samsung Galaxy device in recent years, you'll notice that Samsung Messages didn't come preinstalled" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R8 directly matches models S25, Fold6/Flip6; others confirm newer devices (S26 etc.) have Google Messages pre-installed or no Samsung Messages.

verifications.claim: Users of devices running Android 11 or older are not affected by this change.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Not affected (for now) are devices running Android 11 or older" (R1); "Users of older Android operating systems (dating back to Android 11 or older) will not be impacted" (R3); "If you're using an Android device running Android 11 or older, Samsung says you are not affected" (R4); "Users of an older Android OS (Android 11 or lower) are not affected" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent direct support across multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Users with older smartwatches (pre-Galaxy Watch 4) running Tizen OS may experience limited message support.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "older Tizen watches will no longer be able to see full message conversation history on their watch; however, those watches will still allow the user to read and send text messages" (R1); "Tizen OS watches... can't run Google Messages. These watches will not be able to display full message conversations after July 2026. However, you'll still be able to read and send messages" (R4); "older generation smartwatches with Tizen OS – watches launched before the Galaxy Watch4 – messaging will no longer be supported on these devices" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm limited functionality (read/send but no full history) post-discontinuation.

verifications.claim: Users will lose custom Samsung themes.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Galaxy smartphone owners may lose out on some of the Samsung Messages customization options"
verifications.reasoning: R8 mentions loss of customization options, which broadly includes themes, but not explicitly 'custom Samsung themes'; no other sources mention.

verifications.claim: Users will gain AI-powered features powered by Gemini.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "artificial intelligence features from Google’s Gemini" (R3); "AI-powered features from Google’s Gemini" (R6); "AI-powered features, like Google's Gemini" (R7); "generative AI from Gemini" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state gaining Gemini-powered AI features via Google Messages.
